{{< include ../_provenance.qmd >}}

PHATE and FA2 coordinates are pre-computed in the targets pipeline
(`phate_coords_*`, `fa2_coords_*`) and slotted into the Seurat object via
`CreateDimReducObject()`. The object is kept in memory across all tabs per
compartment so standard `DimPlot()` / `FeaturePlot()` calls apply throughout.

NMF (RcppML) and Diffusion Map (destiny) are computed inline in this notebook
on the HSC compartment using SCT-normalised expression.

```{r setup}
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)
library(RcppML)
library(Matrix)
library(destiny)
library(targets)
source(file.path("src/R/scrna-seq_utilities.R"))
```

```{r params}
targets::tar_load(proc_params)
INSPECT_RES <- 0.5
```

```{r helpers}
cluster_col_res <- function(md, res) {
  pat <- paste0("_res\\.", gsub("\\.", "\\\\.", res), "$")
  grep(pat, colnames(md), value = TRUE)[1]
}

add_dimreduc <- function(srt, coords, name, key) {
  srt[[name]] <- Seurat::CreateDimReducObject(
    embeddings = coords, key = key, assay = DefaultAssay(srt)
  )
  srt
}
```

# 1 · HSC {.tabset}

```{r hsc-load}
targets::tar_load(c(mpn_processed_data_hsc, phate_coords_hsc, fa2_coords_hsc))
srt <- add_dimreduc(mpn_processed_data_hsc, phate_coords_hsc, "phate", "PHATE_")
srt <- add_dimreduc(srt,                    fa2_coords_hsc,   "fa2",   "FA2_")
rm(mpn_processed_data_hsc, phate_coords_hsc, fa2_coords_hsc); gc()
clust_col <- cluster_col_res(srt@meta.data, INSPECT_RES)
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

### UMAP — clusters

```{r hsc-umap-clust}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 6
DimPlot(srt, reduction = "umap.nn", group.by = clust_col, label = TRUE, repel = TRUE) +
  NoLegend() + ggtitle("HSC — UMAP (clusters)")
```

### UMAP — by sample

```{r hsc-umap-sample}
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 8
DimPlot(srt, reduction = "umap.nn", group.by = clust_col,
        split.by = "sample.name",label = TRUE, pt.size = 0.3) +
  NoLegend() + ggtitle("HSC — UMAP by sample")
```

# 4 · NMF — HSC

Non-negative Matrix Factorisation decomposes the SCT expression matrix into
`k` gene programs (**W**, genes × k) and per-cell program activities (**H**, k × cells).
Run on non-HVG genes so the programs capture stable transcriptional structure
not dominated by the features already driving the PCA/UMAP.

```{r nmf-load}
targets::tar_load(mpn_processed_hsc)
clust_col_nmf <- cluster_col_res(mpn_processed_hsc@meta.data, INSPECT_RES)
```

```{r nmf-run}
NMF_K   <- 10L   # number of components — adjust after inspecting MSE elbow below
NMF_SEED <- 42L

mat_nmf <- Seurat::GetAssayData(mpn_processed_hsc, assay = "SCT", layer = "data")

# Exclude HVGs so programs capture stable (non-highly-variable) structure.
# To run on HVGs instead, remove the next line.
mat_nmf <- mat_nmf[!rownames(mat_nmf) %in% Seurat::VariableFeatures(mpn_processed_hsc), ]

cat("Matrix dimensions (genes × cells):", nrow(mat_nmf), "×", ncol(mat_nmf), "\n")

nmf_res <- RcppML::nmf(mat_nmf, k = NMF_K, seed = NMF_SEED, tol = 1e-4, verbose = FALSE)

# Attach per-cell activities as metadata
h_df           <- as.data.frame(t(nmf_res$h))     # cells × k
colnames(h_df) <- paste0("NMF_", seq_len(ncol(h_df)))
rownames(h_df) <- colnames(mpn_processed_hsc)
mpn_processed_hsc <- Seurat::AddMetaData(mpn_processed_hsc, h_df)

cat("NMF complete — k =", NMF_K, "\n")
```

## MSE by component

```{r nmf-mse, fig.width=5, fig.height=4}
# Per-component reconstruction MSE as a rough elbow diagnostic
mse_vals <- sapply(seq_len(NMF_K), function(i) {
  recon <- nmf_res$w[, i, drop = FALSE] %*% nmf_res$h[i, , drop = FALSE]
  mean((mat_nmf - recon)^2)
})

ggplot(data.frame(k = seq_len(NMF_K), mse = mse_vals),
       aes(k, mse)) +
  geom_line(colour = "steelblue4") +
  geom_point(colour = "steelblue4", size = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq_len(NMF_K)) +
  labs(x = "NMF component", y = "MSE",
       title = "Per-component reconstruction MSE") +
  theme_cowplot(font_size = 11)
```

## Program activity — UMAP {.tabset}

```{r nmf-umap, fig.width=14, fig.height=10}
Seurat::FeaturePlot(
  mpn_processed_hsc,
  features  = paste0("NMF_", seq_len(NMF_K)),
  reduction = "umap.nn",
  ncol      = 4,
  pt.size   = 0.2,
  order     = TRUE
) & scale_colour_viridis_c(option = "plasma") &
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 9))
```

## Program activity — by sample

```{r nmf-umap-sample, fig.width=14, fig.height=10}
Seurat::DimPlot(
  mpn_processed_hsc,
  reduction = "umap.nn",
  group.by  = clust_col_nmf,
  split.by  = "sample.name",
  label     = TRUE,
  ncol      = 4,
  pt.size   = 0.3
) + Seurat::NoLegend() + ggtitle("HSC — clusters by sample")
```

## Top genes per component

```{r nmf-top-genes}
w_mat           <- nmf_res$w
rownames(w_mat) <- rownames(mat_nmf)

top_genes_nmf <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(ncol(w_mat)), function(k) {
  scores <- sort(w_mat[, k], decreasing = TRUE)
  data.frame(
    component = paste0("NMF_", k),
    gene      = names(scores)[1:20],
    score     = round(scores[1:20], 4)
  )
}))

DT::datatable(
  top_genes_nmf,
  rownames = FALSE,
  filter   = "top",
  caption  = "Top 20 genes per NMF component (W matrix loading score)",
  options  = list(pageLength = 20, scrollX = TRUE)
)
```

```{r nmf-cleanup}
rm(mat_nmf, nmf_res, h_df, w_mat, top_genes_nmf, mse_vals)
gc()
```

# 5 · Diffusion Map — HSC

Diffusion Map (Coifman & Lafon 2006; `destiny` implementation) captures
continuous manifold structure by computing eigenvectors of the diffusion operator
on the cell–cell similarity graph. The resulting diffusion components are used
to build a UMAP, which is then compared to the SNN-based UMAP.

```{r dm-run}
# Dense cells × HVGs matrix required by destiny
hvg_dm  <- Seurat::VariableFeatures(mpn_processed_hsc)
mat_dm  <- Seurat::GetAssayData(mpn_processed_hsc, assay = "SCT", layer = "data")
mat_dm  <- t(as.matrix(mat_dm[hvg_dm, ]))   # cells × HVGs

cat("DiffusionMap input:", nrow(mat_dm), "cells ×", ncol(mat_dm), "HVGs\n")

set.seed(42)
dm <- destiny::DiffusionMap(mat_dm)

dc_emb           <- destiny::eigenvectors(dm)
rownames(dc_emb) <- colnames(mpn_processed_hsc)
colnames(dc_emb) <- paste0("DC_", seq_len(ncol(dc_emb)))

mpn_processed_hsc[["diffmap"]] <- Seurat::CreateDimReducObject(
  embeddings = dc_emb,
  key        = "DC_",
  assay      = "SCT"
)

# UMAP from diffusion components
mpn_processed_hsc <- Seurat::RunUMAP(
  mpn_processed_hsc,
  reduction      = "diffmap",
  dims           = 1:20,
  reduction.name = "umap_dm",
  reduction.key  = "UMAPdm_",
  verbose        = FALSE
)

cat("Diffusion UMAP ready.\n")
```

## Diffusion components — eigenvalue spectrum

```{r dm-eigenvalues, fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
evals <- destiny::eigenvalues(dm)
ggplot(data.frame(DC = seq_along(evals), eigenvalue = evals),
       aes(DC, eigenvalue)) +
  geom_line(colour = "steelblue4") +
  geom_point(colour = "steelblue4", size = 2) +
  labs(x = "Diffusion component", y = "Eigenvalue",
       title = "Diffusion Map eigenvalue spectrum") +
  theme_cowplot(font_size = 11)
```

## UMAP comparison: SNN-PCA vs Diffusion

```{r dm-umap-compare, fig.width=14, fig.height=6}
p1 <- Seurat::DimPlot(mpn_processed_hsc, reduction = "umap.nn",
                      group.by = clust_col_nmf, label = TRUE, repel = TRUE) +
  Seurat::NoLegend() + ggtitle("SNN-PCA UMAP")

p2 <- Seurat::DimPlot(mpn_processed_hsc, reduction = "umap_dm",
                      group.by = clust_col_nmf, label = TRUE, repel = TRUE) +
  Seurat::NoLegend() + ggtitle("Diffusion Map UMAP")

p1 | p2
```

## Diffusion UMAP — by sample

```{r dm-umap-sample, fig.width=14, fig.height=8}

  mpn_processed_hsc,
  reduction = "umap_dm",
  group.by  = clust_col_nmf,
```

## Top diffusion components on SNN-UMAP

```{r dm-dc-umap, fig.width=14, fig.height=8}
# Attach DC coordinates as metadata for FeaturePlot
dc_meta <- as.data.frame(dc_emb[, 1:6])
mpn_processed_hsc <- Seurat::AddMetaData(mpn_processed_hsc, dc_meta)

Seurat::FeaturePlot(
  mpn_processed_hsc,
  features  = paste0("DC_", 1:6),
  reduction = "umap.nn",
  ncol      = 3,
  pt.size   = 0.2,
  order     = TRUE
) & scale_colour_viridis_c(option = "mako") &
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 9))
```

```{r dm-cleanup}
rm(mat_dm, dm, dc_emb, dc_meta)
rm(mpn_processed_hsc)
gc()
```
